items.q: Can I post the generated text without editing?
items.a: Add your real offer, dates and a photo first. Specific posts perform better than generic ones, and Google can remove posts that break its rules.

items.q: How should I reply to a negative review?
items.a: Thank the reviewer, apologise where fair, offer to fix the issue offline and keep it short. The tool writes a reply for every star rating.

items.q: Is the Google Business Profile writer free?
items.a: Yes. The Google Business Profile post and reply writer is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Does the tool connect to my Google account?
items.a: No. It only writes text, and you paste it into your profile yourself. Nothing is posted for you.

items.q: Can you manage my Google Business Profile?
items.a: Yes. Local SEO, reviews and Business Profile work is part of our SEO team's service.
